sources.title: Emissions from point sources
sources.status: Known-location industrial and commercial point sources with grid references; 2023 XLSX available
sources.verified_fact: Known-location point sources have grid references and can be mapped directly; 2023 point-source workbook is published.
sources.quality_effect: Adds direct facility-location candidate evidence; parcel binding remains a separate unexecuted gate.

sources.title: Gridded Emissions Data
sources.surface: Official NAEI 1×1 km gridded and point-source download
sources.status: Annual 1×1 km grids plus point-source SHP/CSV coordinates for 2005-2023
sources.verified_fact: Downloads include ASCII and GeoTIFF 1×1 km grids plus point-source SHP/CSV site coordinates for greenhouse gases including CO2, methane and nitrous oxide.
sources.quality_effect: Adds spatial screening candidates and coordinate-bearing facility context; no parcel value inferred.

sources.title: UK Spatial Emissions Methodology - National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory 2023
sources.status: Reissued methodology; corrected charts while accompanying gridded data remained valid
sources.verified_fact: The reissued report documents spatial allocation methodology and states the corrected chart issue did not affect accompanying gridded data.
sources.quality_effect: Raises methodology traceability and prevents treating spatial grids as direct parcel measurements.

sources.title: Pollution Inventory
sources.surface: National Data Library official regulated-site release dataset
sources.status: 2024 dataset available; annual mass releases from large regulated industrial sites
sources.verified_fact: The dataset covers annual mass releases to air, controlled waters and sewers from large regulated industrial sites, including point, non-point and fugitive releases; EPSG:27700 metadata is provided.
sources.quality_effect: Adds regulated-site emissions evidence and spatial-reference metadata; conditional licence limits are recorded.
sources.licence_note: Environment Agency Conditional Licence; permitted-use period and reuse restrictions must be checked before production use.

sources.title: Environmental Permitting Regulations - Industrial Sites
sources.surface: National Data Library official industrial-site register
sources.status: Daily-updated EPR process-industry site register with EPSG:27700 metadata
sources.verified_fact: The register covers process-industry installations and larger waste activities with potentially significant releases; spatial reference EPSG:27700 and daily update frequency are stated.
sources.quality_effect: Adds current regulated-facility identity/location candidates; licence and personal-data constraints are recorded.
sources.licence_note: Environment Agency Conditional Licence is limited to one year and includes personal-data compliance conditions.
